title: ApprovalGovernanceContext
description:
The canonical governance context an approval decision must be judged
against. This is a projection of the committed case ledger, not an
explanation composed by the renderer.

eligible_actors.description:
The server resolves approver eligibility per connection. A list view
cannot invent eligible actors before that identity check happens.

purpose_context.description:
The declared purpose and operating context, copied verbatim from the
authority request that the committed decision evaluated. This remains a
structured value because the authority contract deliberately permits
operation-specific purpose fields; callers must not replace it with a
renderer-authored summary.

side_effect_standing.description: An approval is pending because its side effect was not executed.

RebuildStanding.description: Whether the committed source can presently be rebuilt and verified.

SourceFreshness.description: Freshness of the canonical record behind a projection.

SourceRecordRef.description:
A content-addressed, ledger-committed source record behind a view.

This deliberately cannot hold a source file path or code citation.  A
renderer may show implementation location as explanatory material, but a
readiness standing must resolve to a committed record and digest.
